description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Comment' within the Opencart admin module. The class handles event-driven actions related to comments, specifically adding, editing, and deleting comments. For each action, it creates a task to process the comment data asynchronously by calling a task model.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class handling comment-related events in the admin panel.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a task to generate new comment data when a comment is added.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Adds a task to update comment data when a comment is edited.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Adds a task to process comment deletion.
